claim.statement: Google's current code-review guide says a user can click Publish branch or Publish PR to push Jules changes to GitHub; the documented commit and pull-request attribution differs by route.

limitations: The claim covers the named user-triggered publish controls and does not establish every output route available through APIs, automations or later product changes.
No branch, commit or pull request was published or inspected.
unknowns: The selected publish route, repository permissions, branch protections, commit identity and pull-request state of a real task are unknown.
Whether task output remains available, retained or deleted when neither publish control is used is unknown.
